title: About Fixes & Debugging
content:
Thank you for taking the time to visit YURI NO1.

This website is currently built and maintained by our team out of passion, alongside our regular lives and work. We do our best to provide the experience we envision for our visitors.

As our team is limited in size, there may occasionally be oversights in website functionality or proofreading. We sincerely apologize for any imperfections you may encounter.

Thank you for your patience, understanding, and kind support.
